feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 October 2026 7:26am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure will continue moving into the Norwegian Sea and fill, with high pressure building over France and southern Britain.


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7, soon decreasing West or Southwest 5 or 6 this morning, 4 or 5 in the afternoon, then 3 or 4 in the evening. Backing South 3 or 4 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate this morning, then slight in the evening.


##Weather##

A few outbreaks of rain or drizzle at first, but otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, falling moderate or poor in any rain or drizzle at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 3 or 4, increasing South or Southeast 4 or 5 tomorrow morning and afternoon, occasionally 6 in the west of area. Becoming generally South or Southeast 5 or 6 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate, then mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy drizzle for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any drizzle.
